title: pha.yaml — per-document/collection pipeline configuration
description: Sidecar configuration selecting which content rules and models a document or collection uses. Placed next to a document or at a collection root; nearest-wins per key up the directory chain.

palaeographer.title: Palaeographer stage (vision transcription)
palaeographer.description: Which transcription rules and (optionally) vision model to use.

model.description: Optional vision-model override (models/<id>.md). null = use the palaeographer's default model.

editor.title: Editor stage (text transform)
editor.description: Which editing rules and (optionally) text model to use. null = no editor.

model.description: Optional text-model override (models/<id>.md). null = use the editor's default model.

encoders.title: Encoder stages (structured extraction)
encoders.description: Encoders to run, in page order. Omit to auto-discover the collection's encoders/ directory.

model.description: Optional model override (models/<id>.md). null = use the encoder's default model.

render.title: Render / image-extraction settings
render.description: Per-collection overrides of the global extraction.* settings (render_dpi, max_image_px, jpeg_quality).

render_dpi.description: Render resolution in DPI for PDF pages (default 200).

max_image_px.description: Cap the longest rendered edge in pixels (default 1800; set higher to keep native scans).

jpeg_quality.description: JPEG quality for rendered page images (default 88).
